I have written R in 3 public repositories, from 2014 to 2017; in 1 of them it is the main language.

What it was for: [Data and GIS](@/projects/data.md) (2) and [Tools](@/projects/tools.md) (1).

Most recently: [zeman-ucet](@/work/zeman-ucet.md): Zpravy pro prijemce ze Zemanova transparentniho uctu na predvolebni kampan; [datascience](@/work/datascience.md); [apollo-box](@/work/apollo-box.md): All needed data science stuff in one box.

How to read the evidence: every [repository](@/glossary/repository.md) below is measured from GitHub and GitLab (every 6 hours) and says how it uses R: as the main language, as a measured share of its code, in its declared stack or as a topic. The reference graph links R to the repositories and to the other languages and technologies they use together.
